info.name: CareerForge V1 and V2 local API
info.description: CareerForge V1/V2 session-cookie examples; this collection has not been executed as test evidence. Historical V1 QA counts are documented separately. Retain cookies, log in before protected requests, and inspect captured IDs before mutations. V2 recovery tokens come only from private smtp-file messages or actual mail; never export populated tokens or API keys. Password reset changes credentials and invalidates sessions: use a disposable account. Mentor requires optional server-side provider configuration and may consume provider quota. Set comparison IDs and planner dates from actual data. Run folders selectively; they change local records.
